title: House: graphite
line: The house look: dark graphite objects a shade above a near-black ground, cream type, one vermilion, Jost SemiBold, no grain.
source: Picked on 2026-11-24 ("A, graphite") from three options rendered on the face card. Colours from the house STYLE.md section 1: near-black #101012, cream #F2EEE4, one vermilion #FF5F3E; Jost SemiBold. Objects are graphite (0.20, 0.20, 0.225); a slightly warm key with a cool fill; light specular on the plates. Tuned by render on 2026-11-24 so objects read as built: a stronger fill that stops before the backplate (fillReach), so objects separate from the ground while the ground stays dark; colours capped at 0.6 (litCap) so the vermilion renders saturated instead of clipping to peach; a thicker plate and bevel for a side wall and a lit edge; raised rows with a bevel; the quiet tone darkened so it renders as before under the stronger fill.
open: the house face card with its cream rim

previous.why: The values before the graphite tune for thickness and light; PCS.use('house-previous') builds with them.
